lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: My belly hurts. I want some bread. I need to find something soon.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Ellen? What are you doing here at this hour?

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: I... I was just looking for something to eat.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: You look pale. Are you feeling alright?

lines.speaker: General
lines.text: Search the area. She must still be here.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Something is wrong... I feel strange...

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: Don’t fight it. Let me in.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: I need to get her out of here!
